tools.description: List or acknowledge daemon alerts.
tools.name: alerts

tools.description: Local blob cache. Ops: stats, clear. Ask: "How big is the cache?"

kind.description: Cache kind to clear; empty clears all.

tools.name: cache

tools.description: Inspect a crashed-process core file and suggest offline analyzers. Ask: "What crashed in this core dump?"

executable.description: Optional path to the crashed executable.

tools.name: core

tools.description: Read-only database inspection (postgres, mysql, sqlite, mongodb, redis). Ops: discover, overview, schema, relations, stats, sample. Ask: "What database does this app use?" "Show its schema."
tools.name: db

tools.description: Mobile devices work here may be using: Android devices and emulators adb reaches (USB, emulator, or remote via adb connect), booted iOS simulators (macOS), and emulator/simulator processes attributed to roots. Same JSON as `spectra devices --json`. adb is only asked when an adb server already runs, unless start_adb. Ask: "Which emulators are booted, and which worktree started them?"

roots.description: Absolute directories (worktree roots) to attribute emulator and simulator processes to.

start_adb.description: Ask adb even when no adb server runs. This starts an adb server that keeps running.

tools.name: devices

tools.description: Run rules. Finds risky app, JVM, network, storage, and toolchain state. Ask: "What needs attention?"

thread_dump_pids.description: JVM PIDs to thread-dump for jvm-deadlock (live only).

tools.name: diagnose

tools.description: Current daemon host health and optional recent samples.
tools.name: host_health

tools.description: Long-idle holders: processes under roots (or named by pids) alive longer than min_age whose tree used under max_cpu percent of one CPU over a window. Evidence only, never signals. Same JSON as `spectra idle --json`. Ask: "Which lane processes are stuck doing nothing?"

max_cpu.description: Idle means process plus descendants used under this percent of one CPU (default 1).

min_age.description: Only processes alive at least this Go duration (default "10m").

pids.description: PIDs to check (with or instead of roots; one of them is required).

roots.description: Absolute directories whose processes are checked.

window.description: CPU sample Go duration (100ms..30s, default "5s"); the call blocks this long.

tools.name: idle

tools.description: macOS only. Inspect .app bundles: runtime, security, helpers, deps, storage, processes. Ask: "What is this app built with?"

assess_gatekeeper.description: Run the real spctl Gatekeeper assessment (slow, 15s cap per app). Default infers it from the signature.

deep.description: Join live process, open-FD/listening-port, and connection state for each app.

scan_all.description: Inspect every .app under /Applications instead of listing paths.

tools.name: inspect_app

tools.description: Persisted findings. Ops: check, list, acknowledge, dismiss, record_fix, fix_history. Ask: "What issues are open?"
tools.name: issues

tools.description: Cancel a working job: it becomes cancelled at once and its tool is stopped.

job_id.description: Job ID from job_start or job_list.

tools.name: job_cancel

tools.description: This session's jobs, oldest first, including finished ones until they expire.
tools.name: job_list

tools.description: The wrapped tool's result (its text, resource links and structuredContent, exactly as a direct call returns them) once the job is completed or failed. Errors while the job is working.

job_id.description: Job ID from job_start or job_list.

tools.name: job_result

tools.description: Run a slow tool in the background and return its job record at once. tool is one of diagnose, idle, jvm, load, orphans, process, snapshot, spawns, triage (process only for operation=sample, jvm only for flamegraph, snapshot only for create or baseline); arguments are that tool's arguments, checked now. Poll job_status (status working, then completed, failed or cancelled) and fetch the tool's own result with job_result. Ask: "Trace spawns for 30s without blocking."

arguments.description: The wrapped tool's arguments, as for a direct call.

tools.name: job_start

tools.description: A job's record: status (working, input_required, completed, failed, cancelled), statusMessage, the latest progress the tool reported, createdAt, lastUpdatedAt, ttl and pollInterval (ms).

job_id.description: Job ID from job_start or job_list.

tools.name: job_status

tools.description: JVM debug. Ops: list, inspect, explain, thread_dump, gc_stats, vm_memory, heap_histogram, heap_dump, heap_leak_suspects (analyze the .hprof at dest: retained-size leak suspects, accumulation points, paths to GC roots; needs confirm_sensitive), flamegraph, attach. Ops that require the spectra agent (auto-attached by default): mbeans, mbean_read (needs mbean_name+attribute), mbean_invoke (needs mbean_name+mbean_operation), probe. Pass auto_attach=false to opt out. Ask: "Why is PID 123 using heap?"

attribute.description: MBean attribute name (e.g. HeapMemoryUsage). Required for mbean_read.

auto_attach.description: Auto-attach spectra agent when an agent-only op needs it (default true). Set false to opt out.

event.description: Profiler event (jvm flamegraph): cpu, wall, alloc, lock, itimer or ctimer.

mbean_name.description: MBean ObjectName (e.g. java.lang:type=Memory). Required for mbean_read and mbean_invoke.

mbean_operation.description: MBean operation name. Required for mbean_invoke.

tools.name: jvm

tools.description: Ancestors and descendant tree of one pid, with subtree RSS and CPU. Same JSON as `spectra lineage --json`. Ask: "What started PID 123 and what is under it?"
tools.name: lineage

tools.description: Can this machine take another job, and if not, who is using it? Same JSON as `spectra load --json`: verdict (admit/hold/backoff), reason, cause, top_cpu/top_rss tables, families, per-root dirs, devices. On Linux under a cgroup CPU or memory limit, also cgroup (quota, limit, used/available, PSI) and effective_cpus / effective_available_bytes (min of host and cgroup); the verdict still uses host-wide figures. Ask: "Should I start another lane?"

backoff_free_gb.description: Back off when available memory is below this many GiB (default 4).

max_load_per_cpu.description: Hold when 1-minute load is at or above this times the CPU count (default 1.5).

min_free_gb.description: Hold when available memory is below this many GiB (default 8).

roots.description: Absolute directories holding worktrees; cause is "roots" when load leads there.

tools.name: load

tools.description: macOS only. Bounded unified-log queries. Ask: "Show recent errors from backupd."
tools.name: logs

tools.description: Memory pressure and swap: VM compressor on macOS; MemAvailable, PSI stalls and zswap on Linux. Ask: "Is the system under memory pressure?"
tools.name: memory

tools.description: Locally stored process metrics and app churn. Ops: process, churn. Ask: "How has PID 123's memory trended?"
tools.name: metrics

tools.description: Network state and sockets. Ops: state, connections, by_app, diagnose. Ask: "What is this app connected to?"
tools.name: network

tools.description: Leftover processes from worktrees and finished jobs: parent is pid 1 and cwd is under a root. Evidence only, never kills. Same JSON as `spectra orphans --json`: groups (candidates plus daemon_by_design processes), totals, limitations. Ask: "What did finished lanes leave running?"

min_age.description: Ignore processes younger than this Go duration (default "1m").

no_daemon.description: Do not ask the running daemon for recorded spawn origins.

tools.name: orphans

tools.description: Who has this? Pass target (:PORT, tcp:PORT, udp:PORT, an absolute path, or a pid) for `spectra owner --json`, or under (absolute directories) for `spectra owner --under --json`. Ask: "Who is listening on 8080?" "Is anything still running in this worktree?"

target.description: Port, absolute path, or pid. Exactly one of target or under.

under.description: Absolute directories: list processes whose cwd is inside them.

tools.name: owner

tools.description: Built-in diagnostic playbooks and command plans. Ops: list, get. Ask: "How do I triage an fseventsd leak?"
tools.name: playbook

tools.description: Battery, thermal, and energy impact. Ops: state, impact. Ask: "Is the machine throttling?" "What is draining the battery?"

pids.description: PIDs to score (impact). Defaults to all processes.

tools.name: power

tools.description: Live processes. Ops: list, tree, history, by_app (macOS), sample (macOS). Ask: "What is using memory?" "Sample PID 123."
tools.name: process

tools.description: macOS only. launchd jobs and plist schedules. Ask: "What launch agents are installed?"
tools.name: services

tools.description: Capture or compare host state. Ops: create, list, get, diff, baseline. Ask: "What changed since baseline?"
tools.name: snapshot

tools.description: Bounded live trace of process starts and exits by polling (blocks for the duration, at most 30s). Returns {events: [...], summary: {...}}: events are the objects `spectra spawns --json` streams one per line, summary is its final line. Ask: "What keeps spawning under PID 123?"

pid.description: Only trace this process and its descendants (0 or omitted: all).

tools.name: spawns

tools.description: Disk volumes and ~/Library storage footprint. Ask: "What is using all my disk?"

limit.description: How many top apps to report (default 10).

paths.description: .app paths to size for the largest-apps list.

tools.name: storage

tools.description: Kernel resource limits and saturation. Ops: limits, top. Ask: "Are we running out of file descriptors or PTYs?"
tools.name: system

tools.description: macOS only. Time Machine status, destinations, and local snapshots. Ask: "When did Time Machine last back up?"
tools.name: timemachine

tools.description: Dev tools and drift. Ops: scan, jdk, runtimes, build_tools, brew, drift. Ask: "Which JDKs are installed?"
tools.name: toolchain

tools.description: Best first tool. Give app_path, pid, bundle_id, or symptom. Returns summary, evidence, next steps. Ask: "What looks wrong with Slack?"
tools.name: triage

tools.description: macOS only. macOS install/update log. Ops: history, log. Ask: "When was the last OS update?"
tools.name: updates
